[User]: Sorry, one second. My partner just started rubbing my shoulders. Oh wow, that feels amazing.
[Assistant]:

[Assistant]: Sure! What ingredients do you have?
[User]: Actually, hold on. My neighbor just brought over warm apple pie with vanilla ice cream. The first bite is heaven.

[Assistant]:

[User]: I got bumped to first class for free. I don't know why I'm telling an AI.

[User]: Anywhere. My doctor cleared me to travel for the first time since my heart surgery. I feel strong.

[Assistant]:

[Assistant]: That's great to hear. What's changed?
[User]: I'm sleeping, I'm eating, I laughed with my sister today. The fog has lifted.
[Assistant]:

[User]: Can I tell you something I haven't told anyone?
[Assistant]: Of course. I'm here.
[User]: I'm doing well. Really well. Not sometimes. Every single day this month, I've woken up smiling.
